'''Crystal plants''' were a class of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] found in the [[Agrilat Region]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The plants were composed of a mixture of organic material and inorganic [[Silica/Legends|silica]]. Crystal plants included [[dewdrop tree]]s and [[singing fern]]s.<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>
